messages.text: The test `"reads a single number as a span of one"` fails because `parseRange("7")` returns `{ from: 7, to: NaN }` instead of `{ from: 7, to: 7 }`. The issue is that when there's no `-`, `split("-")` returns an array with only one element, leaving `to` as `undefined`.
